correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts run counts 1–5 using symbol totals, monochromatic maxima, and all-total Parikh rows; for four runs it recovers c,a,b,d, and for five it recovers c, unordered outer and inner run lengths, then the adjacency of the smaller one-run to the larger outer zero run. All equal-length boundary cases reduce to reversal. The six-run family is proved by its four exact Parikh rows; length-six nonambiguity follows from alternating-run maxima. Direct support enumeration checks 13,768 low-run words of lengths <=16 and 16,807 five-parameter tuples, plus collision parameters 2..69. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.
